text: Based on the provided tool output, there was indeed deforestation of native forest on the property in 2022. The observation tool detected a tree-cover loss event of 0.6 hectares, which corresponds to 3.41% of the asset's area. The JRC 2020 reference data corroborates that this area was forested in 2020. Furthermore, the MGAP forest map from 2021 confirms that 0.5 hectares of the lost area was native forest. Although there was some loss in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares, the main event meets the specified criteria for deforestation.
